scope: Exploratory broader-domain validation; fixed six-scene test gives measured evidence, not a universal safety guarantee

primary_model.checkpoint: minimum training-declared composite validation loss within fixed5000updates

offline_controls: same-checkpoint blank and unique-scene image shuffle
validation_workflow: offline scene-macro, pre-onset risk and4/8/12s pose/work/attitude metrics
all6 validation arenas online with same model time_risk versus energy_risk
inspect all failures/abstentions; version any change before test freeze

physical_protocol.observation: One fixed pre-drive measured RGBD with measured current state/history
physical_protocol.controller: Native PID with persistent speed integral and steering-only reset for changed path
physical_protocol.comparison: same model, planning seed, candidates and solver; energy cost zero versus positive
physical_protocol.collision: asset OR chassis resultant>1N at solver-rate observations
physical_protocol.rollover: absroll OR abspitch>60deg at solver-rate observations
physical_protocol.primary_success: goal within180s without any declared collision/rollover/boundedstall
physical_protocol.energy: positive engine-interface mechanical work, not fuel
physical_protocol.time_energy_comparison: paired safe full-goal completions only; report unconditional success denominator separately

milestone_gates.vision: RGBD advantage assessed against matched blank and same-checkpoint image controls with scene-level results; no win claimed from aggregate already-failed detection
milestone_gates.complex_planning: at least4of6 protected arenas safe full-goal completion; report every arena and baseline rather than cherry-picked demonstration
milestone_gates.energy_tradeoff: at least5percent mean mechanical-work reduction on paired safe completions with no more25percent mean traversal-time increase; report sample count, every pair and unconditional completion-rate change
milestone_gates.risk: no empirical safety claim unless pre-onset hazard discrimination/calibration and actual physical outcomes agree; unsupported heads remain explicit

failure_policy: If gates fail, report which part failed and keep all outcomes. A successful collection or training process does not establish successful planning.
